Name: Stardew Depixelating Reshade (SDR)
Author: zhekson94
Description:
A simple, performance-friendly Reshade that smooths visuals and makes the game look less pixelated.

There is a mod "Clear Glasses" that does even better work. But for me, performance was pretty bad: big FPS drops, stutters, visual bugs, etc. So I came with my own solution to make Stardew Valley look smoother and less pixelated without performance drops.

In theory it should be compatible with absolutely any existing mod.

Installation:

1. Download ReShade
[url=https://reshade.me/]https://reshade.me/[/url]

2. Launch exe > Select Stardew Valley > Choose OpenGL and in the effects menu choose only the first two (they should be chosen by default).

3. Download my file and extract DepixelationReshade to the main folder (where Stardew Valley.exe is located).

4. Launch the game, press the "home" button, and a new menu will show up. Then press skip introduction/help. After that, choose my file as presented on the screenshot in the overview. That's it, enjoy the game.
